goal: Add `EnvValueRedactor`, `FieldPathRedactor`, `ToolDenylistRedactor`, a `default_policy()` factory of common secret patterns, and salted HMAC-SHA256 stable tokens to `flywheel.redaction`.

references: src/flywheel/redaction.py -- extend the PatternRedactor/compose primitives from redaction-core
constraints: default_policy() ships patterns for at least: Anthropic keys (sk-ant-...), generic sk-... API keys, AWS access key IDs (AKIA...) and secret keys, PEM private-key blocks (-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----), JWTs, GitHub tokens (ghp_/gho_/ghs_), and bearer-token headers (FR-3).

EnvValueRedactor redacts the literal VALUES of explicitly configured env-var names that are present in os.environ, matched wherever they appear in any payload string; it reads os.environ only at construction time and the captured values stay in memory (FR-4).
FieldPathRedactor redacts the entire value at operator-named payload key paths with nested-key and list-element wildcard support (FR-5).
ToolDenylistRedactor redacts the input and result payloads of SdkMessageRecords whose tool name is on a configured denylist, leaving the envelope (type, ids, sequence) intact (FR-6).

With a configured salt, identical cleartext yields an identical `[REDACTED:<label>:<digest>]` token across records (digest = HMAC-SHA256 prefix, one-way, cleartext never recoverable); without a salt the token is bare `[REDACTED:<label>]` (FR-8).
Compiled regexes are reused, not recompiled per record (NFR-2). Output is byte-identical across runs and processes: salt is an explicit input, with no randomness or clock dependence (NFR-3).
A malformed regex in a policy fails fast at construction with a clear error, never mid-stream.
EnvValueRedactor contributes no pattern when the env value is empty or absent (it must not redact every empty string) and excludes values below a configurable minimum length.
flywheel.redaction stays pure: tests/test_redaction_module_purity.py must still pass after adding the os import for EnvValueRedactor.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No changes to flywheel.audit or the CLI (later tasks).
edge_cases: A secret split across two payload fields is redacted in each field independently; no cross-field reconstruction.
A very short (e.g. 1-char) env value is excluded by the minimum-length guard so common substrings are not blanked out.

graders.run: uv run python -c "import flywheel.redaction as r; p = r.default_policy(); assert all(hasattr(r, n) for n in ('EnvValueRedactor', 'FieldPathRedactor', 'ToolDenylistRedactor', 'default_policy'))"
graders.name: public-surface
